title: Software Engineer - 6+yrs - React.js/Angular/Java
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a Software Engineer to develop software aligned with Cisco’s Design Thinking Principles, focusing on simplification and user experience. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute technical documentation, and support product innovation. Ideal for experienced professionals with strong technical expertise and a background in secure coding and agile practices.
description:
Role Overview:

Cisco's Industrial IoT Business Unit (BU) is among the fastest-growing units, generating approximately $1 billion in revenue. It emphasizes innovation, a Customer First mindset, and a One Team culture. As we strengthen our IIoT leadership, we aim to reimagine the Industrial Management portfolio with a focus on Operational Technology (OT) users, delivering a simplified user experience and robust security management.

In this role, you will work as a senior engineer to develop Cisco's IIoT management strategy, prioritizing a streamlined user experience for network and security management to help customers effectively manage their critical industrial networks. You will lead the design, development, and deployment of various features that integrate ruggedized devices, sensors, applications, and networking equipment to collect, monitor, and analyze industrial operational data. Your work will drive innovation to improve operational efficiency, safety, and security in industrial environments by leveraging Cisco's IIoT technologies and industry best practices.

Who You'll Work With:

The Device Management team is a group of high energy, customer focused engineers who bring diverse perspectives and experiences to bear on the toughest engineering challenges.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Drive an AI-first development approach by integrating AI-assisted coding tools and machine learning models into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate routine tasks, improve code quality, and accelerate feature delivery.

Develop and maintain high-performance, scalable services  (using Full stack - Java, Python, or Golang, React JS, Angular) that integrate seamlessly with our IIoT device management platforms.

Partner with UX designers, product managers, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into technical specifications and sophisticated user experiences.

Drive standard processes in front-end and back-end development, including code reviews, unit testing, and performance optimization to ensure low-latency and high-throughput applications.

Actively participate in an agile development environment, contributing to sprint planning, estimation, and the continuous delivery of software solutions.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

6+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on full-stack development and sophisticated web application architecture.

Deep proficiency in modern frontend technologies, specifically ReactJS or Angular, with a strong understanding of state management, component architecture, and web performance optimization.

Backend expertise with solid experience in backend development using Java, Python, or Golang, including the design and consumption of RESTful APIs.

Familiarity with database modeling and technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or relational databases.

Understanding of IT/OT convergence and the outstanding challenges of managing industrial networks is highly desirable.

Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

A strong passion for continuous learning, staying current with emerging web technologies, and applying them to solve real-world industrial problems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

MS/BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding and testing workflows.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
